description: Reviewed summaries transcribed or aggregated from archived OOS and discovery review receipts; figures regenerate from this derived data. No proprietary raw ticks or broker account records.

search.grid: 96 symbol-local 15-minute anchors x 4 OR durations x 3 directions on each symbol

cost_scenarios.S0: Recorded executable Bid/Ask fills, fixed 0.07 lots, gross EUR and normalized price R; no additional historical fee, financing or dividend reconciliation.
cost_scenarios.S1: Current published DE30 Raw Spread commission proxy at USD 0.625 per lot round trip assuming USD1=EUR1 and zero financing, not historical charges.
cost_scenarios.S2: Predeclared EUR2/lot round trip, long financing stress and additional 0.1 index-price units adverse per side; not historical broker fees.

scientific_disposition: CLOSED_REJECT_ECONOMIC_PROMOTION_OF_FROZEN_A_B_C; historical broker NET indeterminate; no calibrated alpha inference.

publication_verification.crosschecks: Original discovery states and displayed heatmap; native discovery and OOS totals, drawdowns and quarterly curves; forensic summaries from owner handoff only. No private strategy replay.

cross_market_addendum.verification: Original discovery archive/member hashes and all grid values, missing states, counts, examples and absent supported regions reconciled; no strategy replay.

definition.invalid: null, not 0R; includes two scientifically valid JP cells with 0 completed trades and undefined mean
definition.regional_screen: three adjacent anchors by two adjacent durations, all valid, each >=100 trades, aggregate price R >0, PF >1, >=3/4 positive signal years
definition.value: mean executed price-space R per filled trade

source.period: 2020-02 through 2023-11 signal origins with Dec 2023 burnoff
